dslRule:
<!id: remove-redundant-nonnullbydefault-method-class>
<!description: Remove @NonNullByDefault annotation from a method if its enclosing class is already annotated with @NonNullByDefault, making the method-level annotation redundant.>
<!severity: HINT>
@org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.NonNullByDefault void $name($params$) :: containsAnnotation("org.eclipse.jdt.annotation.NonNullByDefault")
=> void $name($params$)
;;
summary: Remove redundant @NonNullByDefault from a method if its enclosing class also has it.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
